# CinemaMapped

> An interactive map showing where WWII films and series are SET — not where they were filmed, but where the historical events portrayed actually took place.

## What is CinemaMapped?

CinemaMapped (https://cinemamapped.com) is a free web tool that maps the real historical locations of World War II films and series. Every pin marks the actual place where the story happened — the real battlefield, city, or building — not the film set or studio location.

The distinction matters: Saving Private Ryan was FILMED in Ireland but is SET at Omaha Beach, Normandy, France. CinemaMapped shows Omaha Beach.

## Dataset

- 282 pinned locations
- 194 films and series
- 45 countries
- 6 theatres of war: Western Front, Eastern Front, Pacific, North Africa, Atlantic, Mediterranean
- Each pin includes: exact location, scene description, historical context, year portrayed

## Sample data points

- Saving Private Ryan | Omaha Beach, Normandy, France | Western Front | 1944
- Saving Private Ryan | Ramelle (fictional, based on Ramelle-sur-Merderet area), Normandy, France | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Brécourt Manor, Normandy, France | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Carentan, Normandy, France | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Eindhoven, Netherlands | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Arnhem Bridge, Netherlands | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Bastogne, Belgium | Western Front | 1944
- Band of Brothers | Foy, Ardennes, Belgium | Western Front | 1945
- Band of Brothers | Haguenau, Alsace, France | Western Front | 1945
- Band of Brothers | Berchtesgaden & Eagle's Nest, Germany | Western Front | 1945
- Band of Brothers | Landsberg concentration camp, Bavaria, Germany | Western Front | 1945
- Schindler's List | Kraków Ghetto, Poland | Eastern Front | 1941
- Schindler's List | Płaszów concentration camp, Kraków, Poland | Eastern Front | 1943
- Schindler's List | Brünnlitz (now Brněnec), Sudetenland, Czech Republic | Eastern Front | 1944
- The Pacific | Guadalcanal, Solomon Islands | Pacific | 1942

## Key questions this site answers

- Where is Band of Brothers set? (Brécourt Manor, Carentan, Eindhoven, Nijmegen, Bastogne, Foy, Haguenau, Landsberg, Berchtesgaden)
- Where is Saving Private Ryan set? (Omaha Beach, Normandy, France — not Ireland where it was filmed)
- Where is Schindler's List set? (Kraków Ghetto, Płaszów concentration camp, Brünnlitz factory)
- Where is The Pianist set? (Warsaw Ghetto, Warsaw, Poland)
- Where is Downfall set? (Berlin, Germany — the Führerbunker, April 1945)
- Where is Das Boot set? (La Rochelle, France — Atlantic submarine base)
- Where is Dunkirk (2017) set? (Dunkirk beaches, northern France)
- Where is The Pacific set? (Guadalcanal, Peleliu, Iwo Jima, Okinawa)

## Individual location pages

Every pin has its own page at: https://cinemamapped.com/locations/{slug}

Examples:
- https://cinemamapped.com/locations/saving-private-ryan-omaha-beach-normandy
- https://cinemamapped.com/locations/band-of-brothers-bastogne
- https://cinemamapped.com/locations/schindlers-list-plaszow-concentration-camp-krakow
- https://cinemamapped.com/locations/downfall-fuhrerbunker-berlin
